title: Activación y pruebas del Metrics Snapshot Log
purpose: Conservar evidencia de la creación del ledger append-only, del módulo P0 de captura y de las pruebas de E0/E24 e idempotencia ejecutadas fuera del ledger productivo.
author: Manus AI (CGO)

implemented_components.raw_evidence: One immutable JSON file per capture attempt
implemented_components.window_rule: Only valid E0 plus valid E24/E72 with the same post ID can produce a delta; lifetime observations never fill contractual windows.

isolated_tests.fixture_scope: Temporary ledger under /tmp/usm_metrics_snapshot_test; no production rows created.

e0_retry.behavior: Existing valid Logical_Key returned without appending a duplicate row.

remaining_gap: The ledger and capture module are active and validated, but the hook after a real publication and the recurring E24/E72 worker still require integration and an explicit runtime decision. The next real publication must create the first production E0; no historical E0 may be reconstructed.
